groups.contract: NumPy and ZIP checked native ranges/cardinalities before decode publication
groups.evidence: Personally read npy1–186/zip1–232. NPZ delegation633 connects these bodies. Dtype parsing selects little-endian native widths; rejects unsupported descriptor/Fortran order. Parser computes header/payload ranges then builds local array; ZIP maps/owns read-only bytes, scans EOCD with saturated starting bounds, fills local entries and decodes stored/deflate.
qualifications: Concrete malformed/extreme API counterexamples saved separately; no actual asset/run.

to_f32 F64 cast may overflow/nonfinite; to_i64 float conversion saturates, to_bool iterates raw bytes regardless dtype. These APIs carry raw tensor conversion policy rather than a finite bespoke guarantee. Public shape/dtype mutation can diverge bytes; actual consumers must retain canonical cohort.
groups.acceptance: Checked whole parser ranges/count/offset/decode capacities and explicit conversion policy, preserving legal dtype/native payload semantics.

groups.contract: Outer-layer clipped triangle projection and inverse-mass native arithmetic

Face membership and position/velocity/mass cohorts prerequisite; no ordinary bad face or actual solver failure asserted.
